review_candidates.title: Regional Payroll Lead (Food Ingredients), LATAM
review_candidates.description: Job Summary IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers. What's your next big career move? If it involves helping build and stabilize payroll operations across a dynamic and diverse region, we should talk. The Regional Payroll Lead, LATAM will lead the execution, implementation, and stabilization of payroll operations across Latin America as the Food Ingredients business transitions to a standalone organization. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Payroll , this role is responsible for translating global payroll strategy into local execution across the region, ensuring payroll readiness, implementation success, operational compliance, and service delivery excellence across multiple countries. Working closely with ADP, TMF, local payroll resources, and key regional stakeholders, this leader will oversee payroll delivery, vendor performance, compliance, controls, and issue resolution while supporting the successful stand-up of a new global payroll organization. The Regional Payroll Lead will lead regional payroll resources and serve as the primary point of accountability for payroll performance and service delivery across LATAM. The Regional Payroll Lead, LATAM will play a critical role in supporting the Food Ingredients business as it transitions to a standalone organization. This role will lead payroll implementation, vendor coordination, service delivery, and operational readiness activities across the Latin America region. With the global payroll strategy and vendor model already established, this leader will be responsible for ensuring successful regional execution—driving country readiness activities, supporting payroll implementations, managing vendors, overseeing local payroll resources, and ensuring a compliant and stable payroll operation across all countries within the region. This role requires strong multi-country payroll expertise, vendor management capability, stakeholder partnership, and the ability to operate effectively within a fast-moving transformation environment. Following implementation, the role will continue to lead payroll operations across the region while driving service excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement. Brazil would be preferred location for this role, but other locations can be considered as well. Where You'll Make a Difference Lead the execution, implementation, and stabilization of payroll operations across the LATAM region as the Food Ingredients business transitions to a standalone organization. Own regional payroll delivery against the global payroll project plan, ensuring country readiness activities, testing, risks, dependencies, and implementation milestones are actively managed. Drive payroll readiness and successful transition activities across all countries within scope, partnering closely with global payroll leadership, vendors, and regional stakeholders. Oversee end-to-end payroll operations across the region, ensuring payroll is accurate, timely, compliant, and delivered in accordance with country-specific requirements. Lead and develop regional payroll resources, providing direction, coaching, and support to local payroll teams while ensuring consistent service delivery and operational execution. Manage day-to-day relationships with payroll vendors, including ADP and TMF, ensuring service levels, contractual commitments, and country-specific requirements are met. Act as the primary escalation point for regional payroll issues, coordinating resolution across vendors, local teams, and internal stakeholders. Partner closely with HR, Finance, Tax, Legal, Controllership, and business leaders to ensure alignment on payroll inputs, outputs, funding, reporting, and compliance requirements. Support the implementation and maintenance of payroll controls, governance processes, standard operating procedures, and audit requirements. Monitor payroll performance metrics, vendor performance, compliance risks, and operational effectiveness, driving continuous improvement across the region. Support transition from implementation to steady-state operations while helping establish a scalable, compliant, and future-ready payroll function. What Makes You The Right Fit Extensive payroll experience with significant multi-country LATAM payroll leadership responsibilities. Strong experience managing payroll operations across multiple countries, including oversight of payroll vendors and local payroll teams. Demonstrated experience supporting payroll implementations, transitions, or transformation initiatives within complex multinational organizations. Strong understanding of payroll compliance, controls, governance, statutory requirements, and country-specific payroll practices across Latin America. Experience supporting payroll operations in unionized environments, including collective bargaining agreements, labor union requirements, statutory employment obligations, and country-specific payroll practices across Latin America. Experience managing vendor-led payroll delivery models and driving vendor accountability against service levels and operational performance expectations. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, risks, and operational activities in a fast-paced environment. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively across HR, Finance, Legal, Tax, IT, and business leadership. Experience leading teams, coaching payroll professionals, and creating a culture of accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement. Strong communication in English and Portuguese, as well as problem-solving, execution, and organizational skills. How Would You Stand Out? Prior experience working with ADP, TMF, or similar global payroll providers. Experience leading payroll stand-up, carve-out, separation, or transformation activities. Experience operating within a shared services, global business services, or outsourced payroll environment and experience within a manufacturing, industrial, food, ingredients, or similarly complex operational environment. Why Choose Us? Be part of a meaningful business transformation with global reach and impact. Play a key role in building and stabilizing payroll operations across a diverse and growing region. Work closely with global payroll leadership and senior stakeholders to shape a future-state payroll organization. Lead regional teams and vendor partnerships while driving operational excellence and service delivery. Join a purpose-driven organization focused on innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. Your potential is our inspiration. Important Information Regarding This Position For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Food Ingredient business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to CVC Capital Partners. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners. We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability. Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

Ivaco Rolling Mills is looking for Certified: Industrial Mechanic Millwrights with 3 to 5 years experiences, to join our maintenance department. Applicants should have a good working knowledge of hydraulics, gas and pneumatic equipment, CMMS, welding and burning equipment, and be able to work as part of a team as well as independently. Performs work with a minimum of direction. Inspects mill equipment for defects such as misalignment, wear, insufficient lubrication, etc. Determines the best way of making repairs to minimize interruption of production. review_candidates.title: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays
review_candidates.company: Zero to One Search | Recruitment Agency
review_candidates.description: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays Location: Germering, on-site About the hiring company: Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. What makes Dcubed special is that each of us is a space explorer at heart. At Dcubed, we enable the future of space missions with high-performance, flight-proven release mechanisms and deployable structures. From cutting-edge Release Actuators to scalable Deployable Solar Arrays and innovative Deployable Antennas, our technologies are designed for user friendliness, availability, and reliability — whether for smallsats in LEO or large missions to Moon, Mars and beyond. About the role In space, there are no second chances. As Mechanisms Engineer – Solar Arrays (f/m/d) , you will be responsible for the deployment systems at the heart of dcubed's solar arrays. You will design, prototype, test, and qualify the hardware that allows spacecraft to generate power once they reach orbit. We are looking for an engineer with a builder's mindset: someone who can move seamlessly from CAD models and FEM analyses to the workshop and test lab, turning ambitious ideas into reliable flight hardware. If you are motivated by ownership, speed, and the challenge of making space mechanisms work where repair is impossible, you'll fit right in. Responsibilities Mechanism Design & Development: Design, analyze, and develop space-qualified deployment mechanisms and motion systems for Solar Array products, from concept through flight hardware delivery. Technical Expertise: Provide expert guidance on mechanism design, materials selection, lubrication, coatings, thermal effects, motorization margins, tolerancing, and reliability for space applications. Manufacturing & Prototyping: Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles, generate production-ready technical drawings, and support rapid prototyping and manufacturing activities using additive manufacturing and conventional machining techniques. System Integration: Ensure seamless integration of mechanisms with structural, electrical, and deployment subsystems while balancing performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule requirements. Testing & Qualification: Define, support, and execute development, qualification, and acceptance test campaigns, including deployment, vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, and lifetime testing. Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Investigate anomalies, perform root-cause analysis, and implement design improvements to enhance mechanism performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Documentation: Maintain engineering documentation including CAD models, technical drawings, specifications, analyses, test procedures, and qualification reports. Candidate requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in mechanism design, aerospace engineering, precision mechanical systems, or related fields. Strong knowledge of space mechanisms, including bearings, gears, springs, hinges, release systems, lubrication, coatings, wear mechanisms, thermal effects, and motorization sizing and margins. Expert-level CAD proficiency (SolidWorks preferred) and familiarity with FEM tools (ANSYS preferred). Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, GD&T, tolerancing, and technical drawing generation. Experience applying Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles. Hands-on experience with prototyping and fabrication methods including 3D printing, milling, turning, laser cutting, CNC machining, and hardware assembly. Familiarity with space qualification methods and standards, including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, deployment, and lifetime testing. Knowledge of ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace standards is highly desirable. Fluent English skills. Eligibility to work in Germany. Feel free to apply here or directly via https://dcubed.teamtailor.com/jobs/8186378-mechanisms-engineer-solar-arrays-f-m-d

review_candidates.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
review_candidates.description: Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work. Job Title Mechanical Design Engineer Reporting To Manager, Design Engineering Work Schedule Onsite – Phoenix, AZ Mission & Impact The Mechanical Engineering department at Moog Gilbert is looking for a motivated mechanical engineer to join a team that designs and packages spacecraft electronics. You will own the mechanical elements of integrated avionics units end to end: hardware design and electronics packaging, structural/thermal analysis, documentation, and environmental testing — and you’ll see your work directly contribute to mission readiness and customer acceptance. If you bring strong CAD experience with hands on hardware design, we’ll train you on Moog’s tools and processes (e.g., ANSYS Workbench, SolidWorks, Teamcenter). You do not need every preferred skill to apply; strong candidates typically meet ~80% and show willingness to learn. What You’ll Do Mechanical Design for Spacecraft Avionics: Design and develop spacecraft avionics assemblies using SolidWorks 3D CAD software. Produce dimensioned and annotated drawings of piece parts and assemblies per ASME Y14.5. Structural and Thermal Analysis: Develop closed-form and finite element model solutions (using ANSYS Workbench) to address and assess structural and thermal requirements of the design. Documentation of Results: Produce detailed design reviews and analysis reports documenting design, structural, and thermal analyses. Environmental Test Planning and Execution: Develop detailed test plans for hardware per customer requirements for vibration, shock, and thermal testing. Experience analysing customer behaviour, pricing strategies, and commercial performance in a fast-growing business.
